grammar.summary: 本课介绍维拉萨诺大桥，语法上突出由 which/whom 引导的定语从句（含介词前置 whom）、so...that... 结果状语从句，以及 were + 过去分词构成的对将来的虚拟（if the bridge were packed...）。叙述中还出现分词短语 fulfilling... 作伴随状语。

points.title: 介词前置的关系代词定语从句 (Preposition + Relative Pronoun)
points.explanation: 介词可放在关系代词之前，指人用 whom，指物用 which。本课 about whom little is known 中 whom 指人（维拉萨诺），介词 about 前置，整体修饰 Verrazano，句式正式而紧凑。

examples.en: Verrazano, an Italian about whom little is known, sailed into New York Harbour in 1524 and named it Angouleme.
examples.cn: 1524年，一位鲜为人知的意大利人维拉萨诺驾船驶进纽约港，并将该港名为安古拉姆。

examples.en: The Verrazano Bridge, which was designed by Othmar Ammann, joins Brooklyn to Staten Island.
examples.cn: 维拉萨诺大桥由奥斯马·阿曼设计，连结着布鲁克林与斯塔顿岛。

points.title: so...that... 结果状语从句 (Result Clauses)
points.explanation: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句，表示「如此……以至于……」。本课桥身 so long that 设计者不得不考虑地表弧度，用 so 修饰 long，that 引出结果。

examples.en: The bridge is so long that the shape of the earth had to be taken into account by its designer.
examples.cn: 由于桥身太长，设计者不得不考虑了地表的形状。

points.title: 虚拟语气对将来的假设 (Subjunctive for Unreal Present/Future)
points.explanation: 在条件句中用 were（不论人称）表与现在/将来相反的假设，主句用 would + 动词。本课 if the bridge were packed with cars, it would still only be carrying a third... 是对假设情况的结果估计，were 表非真实条件。

examples.en: It has been estimated that if the bridge were packed with cars, it would still only be carrying a third of its total capacity.
examples.cn: 据估计，若桥上摆满了汽车，也只不过是桥的总承载力的1/3。

exercises.q: Verrazano, an Italian ______ whom little is known, sailed into New York Harbour in 1524...
The bridge is ______ long that the shape of the earth had to be taken into account by its designer.
It has been estimated that if the bridge ______ packed with cars, it would still only be carrying a third of its total capacity.（虚拟语气）
用关系代词填空：The Verrazano Bridge, ______ was designed by Othmar Ammann, joins Brooklyn to Staten Island.（指物，非限制性从句）
